hooks.command: [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] > $null; $template = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::GetTemplateContent([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastTemplateType]::ToastText02); $toastXml = [xml] $template.GetXml(); $toastXml.GetElementsByTagName('text')[0].AppendChild($toastXml.CreateTextNode('Claude Code')) > $null; $toastXml.GetElementsByTagName('text')[1].AppendChild($toastXml.CreateTextNode('Claude Code needs your attention')) > $null; $xml = New-Object Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument; $xml.LoadXml($toastXml.OuterXml); $toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($xml); [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier('Claude Code').Show($toast)
